stem: Ishaan's school has two taps on the same tank. Tap A alone fills the tank in $6$ days. Tap B alone fills the tank in $3$ days. Both taps run together on that tank.

parts.text: Which claim correctly finds how long they take together?

options.text: Convert to one-day rates $\dfrac{1}{6}$ and $\dfrac{1}{3}$, add the rates, then convert the combined rate back to days.
Use only Tap B's $3$ days, because $3$ is smaller.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Together the one-day rates add: $\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{3}=\dfrac{1}{2}$ of the tank per day, so the tank fills in $2$ days.

teacher.key_rationale: Rates add, then invert: 1/6+1/3=1/2 tank per day → 2 days. Adding the days or keeping only the smaller time omit the rate step.
